parameters:
この村は見ての通り寂れてるけど、
魚だけはまあ、いいものを揃えてるわ。
昔の名残で腕利きの釣り人が多いからね。<EN>This village is as you can see pretty run-down,
but when it comes to fish, well, we've got a
good selection. There are a lot of skilled
fishermen here, a remnant of the old days.

有名な雫村の店もこの村の魚を仕入れてるのよ。
行くことがあったら食べてみてね。<EN>The famous shops in Shizuku Village also source
their fish from this village. If you ever go
there, give it a try.

わあ！
さかなだ！<EN>Wow! It's a fish!
